title: The inhibition of beta-catenin activity by luteolin isolated from Paulownia flowers leads to growth arrest and apoptosis in cholangiocarcinoma.
authors: Yang, Haibo; Zhao, Yaying; Song, Wei; Fan, Guoqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究木犀草素与β-catenin蛋白的分子对接及结合机制，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅涉及分子对接和实验验证，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联极弱。
abstract: To develop an inhibitor targeting the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway, flavonoid monomer that can interact with beta-catenin was isolated from Paulownia flowers. Luteolin may form stable hydrogen bonds with beta-catenin by molecular docking. Fluorescence quenching analysis determined the physical interaction between luteolin and beta-catenin. The binding of luteolin to beta-catenin caused a loss of alpha-helical structure and induced a conformational change through circular dichroism spectroscopy. Luteolin inhibits the activity of the Wnt signaling, causing cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) cell cycle arrest in the G2/M phase, leading to cell apoptosis and inhibition of cell migration. In addition, transcriptome and proteomics analysis showed that the differentially expressed proteins were significantly enriched in the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. beta-catenin protein in the nucleus was significantly decreased, while C-Myc and cyclin D1 in the CCA cells were significantly decreased after luteolin treatment. Additionally, activation of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling reversed the inhibitory effect of luteolin on the migration of CCA cells. Therefore, luteolin can directly interact with beta-catenin and act as an inhibitor of beta-catenin, inhibiting proliferation and reducing the migration ability of CCA cells by inhibiting the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. This study provides a scientific basis for the development of Wnt/beta-catenin pathway inhibitors and the prevention and treatment of CCA.
abstract_zh: 为开发靶向Wnt/β-catenin信号通路的抑制剂，从泡桐花中分离出能与β-catenin相互作用的黄酮单体。分子对接显示木犀草素可与β-catenin形成稳定氢键。荧光淬灭分析确定了木犀草素与β-catenin之间的物理相互作用。圆二色谱表明，木犀草素与β-catenin的结合导致α-螺旋结构丧失并诱导构象变化。木犀草素抑制Wnt信号活性，使胆管癌（CCA）细胞周期阻滞于G2/M期，进而诱导细胞凋亡并抑制细胞迁移。此外，转录组和蛋白质组学分析显示，差异表达蛋白显著富集于Wnt/β-catenin通路。木犀草素处理后，细胞核中β-catenin蛋白显著减少，而CCA细胞中C-Myc和cyclin D1显著降低。另外，激活Wnt/β-catenin信号可逆转木犀草素对CCA细胞迁移的抑制作用。因此，木犀草素能直接与β-catenin相互作用，作为β-catenin抑制剂，通过抑制Wnt/β-catenin通路抑制CCA细胞增殖并降低其迁移能力。本研究为开发Wnt/β-catenin通路抑制剂及CCA的预防和治疗提供了科学依据。
